    The fundamental groupoid of a ray category #

    The quiver of a ray category P has the irreducible morphisms as arrows (RayVert P). Its fundamental groupoid is the free groupoid on this quiver modulo the homotopy relation v ≃ w for paths v, w with the same nonzero value in P (Gabriel–Roiter 14.1; Bongartz, Indecomposables live in all smaller lengths, Section 2). The vertex groups are the fundamental groups Π(P, x) that the universal cover of P realizes as deck groups.
